title: Colts WR Keenan Allen arrested, charged with DUI after making preseason debut
content:
INDIANAPOLIS — Indianapolis Colts wide receiver Keenan Allen was arrested Sunday morning for driving while intoxicated, one day after he made his preseason debut, according to online jail records. Allen was charged with DWI/DUI/OWI endangering a person and DWI/DUI/OWI with a blood alcohol level of .08 or more, according to the records. Both charges are misdemeanors.

“We are aware of the incident involving Keenan Allen last night. We are in the process of gathering more information and have no further comment at this time,” the Colts said in a statement.

Allen played in the Colts’ preseason finale against the Detroit Lions, recording one catch for 24 yards in the 25-16 loss. The six-time Pro Bowler said afterward that he was excited to get back on the field as he begins his 14th NFL season.

This is a developing story and will be updated.
